summary: @servicetitan/hash-browser-router preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the Bun executable to a temp directory, chmods it +x, and invokes it against the tarball's local `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using string-array-rotation (function `WV8StW` shifting a mixed numeric/string array `n7gIxM`) with randomized identifiers, unrelated to hash-based routing. The alternate-runtime dropper evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code: on `npm install`, opaque bundled bytes are automatically executed on the installer's machine under a separately-fetched runtime. The React hash-router content in dist/ serves as cover for the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
